outcome: Maternal complications during pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum
Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
finding: Pregnant women with portal hypertension experienced high rates of maternal (72.7%) and perinatal complications (54.5% preterm birth, 45.5% NICU admission), highlighting the need for interdisciplinary care.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was 72.7%, with 5 out of 8 performed for obstetric or fetal indications.
